summary: This standards-track document adds an entry to the registry of properties used in Authentication-Results mail header fields. It lets a mail system pass along the result of a Vouch By Reference query, a method for a trusted party to vouch for the sender. Later mail systems can then see that result.

eli5.summary: When mail arrives, the receiver can write notes about checks made. This adds a place to note whether someone trustworthy vouched for the sender.

questions: how to record vbr result in email header
